name: csk_hanoi_pipeline
description: COSMO-SkyMed HIMAGE ascending, central Hanoi, 18 epochs 2011-07-01..2014-12-12, the production chain of hanoi_csk: raw HDF5 -> native stripmap stack -> phase linking (adaptive, Anderson-Darling SHP, Gaussian post-filter) -> ps engine -> product. The project configuration is frozen in csk_hanoi_pipeline.toml; the AOI is cut to 2.6 x 2.6 km to keep the run short.
